rules: An item exists because the same failure reached a PR gate or main at least twice; `source` names where that is recorded.
A trigger is readable from the diff alone: changed paths (globs) or added/removed lines (regex).
`examples` are paths or diff lines that must trigger the item; test_reliability_checklist.py runs them.
An item that has not matched a real failure for a quarter is removed in the monthly review.

items.title: Migration number taken on main in the meantime
items.check: bash .claude/skills/oteryn-dev/scripts/dup-migrations.sh origin/main  (any output: renumber above main and every open PR)

items.title: Generated content, pins and digests stale
items.check: python3 tools/content-migration/regenerate_content.py --resolve, then a second run must leave no diff; never hand-edit generated files

items.title: Node startup, stack size or dispatch runtime: node boot and integration shards run only after merge
items.check: run node boot (bash tools/qualification/node_boot/run.sh, NODE_BOOT_RESULT=NODE_BOOT_PASS) or the matching integration shard locally, or dispatch node-boot-qualification.yml on the branch

items.title: gameplay-dispatch or gameplay-entities test-support only compiles with --all-features
items.check: cargo clippy --locked -p <package> --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings and cargo test --locked -p <package> --all-features

items.title: A PostgreSQL case that passes without a database proves nothing
items.check: run the one filtered PostgreSQL target against a real database and show it executed (its marker and a non-trivial duration); otherwise report it as not run

items.title: Test relies on state left by another test (passes under cargo test, fails under nextest)
items.check: cargo nextest run -p <package> (one process per test, as CI) when nextest is installed

items.title: Additive merge driver left a duplicated mod line or block (E0428)
items.check: after merging origin/main: grep the touched files for duplicated mod lines, imports and test bodies, then cargo fmt --all and build

items.title: Workflow or repository-tool change
items.check: python3 tools/repository/validate_repository_policy.py and every tools/repository/test_*.py; timeouts, budgets and recursion limits change only with the owner's consent

items.title: Pipeline hides the exit status (tee, tail) or errexit stops before evidence is written
items.check: set -o pipefail or read ${PIPESTATUS[0]}; on a step that must record evidence after a failure, turn errexit off and capture the status inside each branch; simulate the step with a failing stub

items.title: Logs or evidence published without redaction
items.check: drop lines matching password|postgres://|mysql://|secret|token|key|grant before upload; never print a database URL or password

items.title: Node boot harness change
items.check: bash -n tools/qualification/node_boot/run.sh, python3 tools/qualification/node_boot/test_diagnostics.py, python3 tools/qualification/node_boot/test_matrix.py when present, and python3 tools/repository/test_heavy_gate.py

items.title: Agent governance files
items.check: python3 tools/agents/validate_governance.py and python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/agents/tests
